title: An LLM-Assisted AutoML Framework for Intrusion Detection in IoT Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.23097v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) systems are increasingly deployed in smart homes, transportation, energy systems, and critical infrastructure. This broad connectivity improves service intelligence, but also enlarges the attack surface of IoT networks. Machine Learning (ML)-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) are widely used to identify malicious network threats and protect IoT systems, but developing effective ML-based IDS models often requires human expertise and repeated manual decisions on many procedures, including data pre-processing, feature selection, model selection, and hyperparameter tuning. Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) reduces this burden by automating steps of the ML pipeline using optimization techniques, but conventional AutoML methods can consume substantial optimization time because they explore broad candidate model families and large hyperparameter spaces. translated_title: 一种用于物联网网络入侵检测的大语言模型辅助自动化机器学习框架
translated_abstract: 物联网系统正日益广泛地部署于智能家居、交通、能源系统和关键基础设施中。这种广泛的连接性提升了服务的智能化水平，但同时也扩大了物联网网络的攻击面。基于机器学习的入侵检测系统被广泛用于识别恶意网络威胁并保护物联网系统，然而开发有效的基于机器学习的入侵检测模型通常需要人类专业知识，并在数据预处理、特征选择、模型选择和超参数调优等诸多流程中反复进行人工决策。自动化机器学习通过利用优化技术将机器学习流程中的步骤自动化，从而减轻了这一负担，但传统的自动化机器学习方法由于需要探索广泛的候选模型家族和庞大的超参数空间，可能会消耗大量的优化时间。本文提出了一种大语言模型辅助的……
tldr: 本文提出一种由大语言模型辅助的自动化机器学习框架，旨在降低物联网网络入侵检测模型开发中的人工成本与优化时间开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-assisted AutoML framework to reduce human effort and optimization time in developing intrusion detection models for IoT networks.
